description: This file defines the ContactsViewList class, which extends ViewList and customizes its preDisplay method to include PDF template handling and initializes a ContactsListViewSmarty object.

classes.name: ContactsViewList
classes.description: A view class for displaying a contacts list with custom pre-display processing.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overrides the parent preDisplay method to include PDF template setup and initialize the contacts list view.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Handles actions to perform before displaying the view, including loading a PDF letter template and setting up the list view.
